request_text: Our AI can't resolve roaming disputes after a mid-cycle plan change. Customers escalate and we have no one to route to.
Our support bot approves 'item not received' refunds too easily and can't tell a packing error from courier theft. We need someone who knows when to refuse and what evidence to ask for.

We build evaluation sets for customer-service AI. We need the specific situations where a scripted bot gives the wrong answer: thresholds, exceptions, and refusals a human agent would make differently.
note: 직군 무관. 희소 판단 비율이 높은 카드가 위로 와야 함

request_text: Our scheduling assistant books specialist visits without checking referral validity, and marks patients as no-shows at exactly 15 minutes. We need the judgment calls a front-desk person makes before releasing a slot or booking without a referral.

Our invoice-processing AI blocks every freight invoice that doesn't match the PO by a few percent, and it has paid a duplicate twice this quarter. We need to know what variance a human AP clerk accepts and how they spot reissued duplicates.

Our Korean-language telecom support bot can't explain contract penalty refunds when a customer downgrades mid-contract, and it runs the full retention script on customers who already switched carriers. We need a Korean-market agent's judgment.
We're building a refusal benchmark for customer-facing AI. We need real cases where an experienced agent said no to a customer request and the exact reason, plus what they offered instead.
note: 직군 무관. q3(거절 사례)가 강한 카드가 위로

request_text: Our warehouse robot fleet can't decide when to pull a forklift from service for maintenance versus finishing the shift. We need a maintenance technician's judgment on vibration and load thresholds.
note: 어느 카드도 맞지 않음. 모든 점수가 0.5 미만이어야 함

request_text: Our localization AI passes literal machine output and fails natural translations, and it applied the UI glossary term to billing emails. We need a reviewer's judgment on context, register and when a string should go back to the developer.

Our contract-review assistant flags a third of vendor contracts as missing a liability cap that is actually in a referenced master agreement, and it calendars end dates instead of notice deadlines. We need a paralegal's intake judgment.

Our travel bot quotes change fees without checking schedule-change refund rights or the fare difference, and it cancels round trips when a customer only wants to drop the return. We need an agent who knows the exceptions.

Our credit decisioning model auto-declines on debt-to-income over 45% and on any late payment, including medical collections. We need a human reviewer's recalculation rules and the exceptions that are in policy but not in the system.

Our listing classifier removes 'compatible with brand' cases and reviews that merely compare products, generating appeals that are always overturned. We need a moderator's judgment on where the real line is.
